format: UCWDC contests, same-division heats and co-mingling

source.quote_free_summary: A heat is made only of the same division 'If space, time, and circumstance allow'; when a division needs more than one heat it 'may' be co-mingled with other divisions; all heats 'may' be co-mingled if space, time and circumstance require.

requirement: A UCWDC profile must allow co-mingling as a permitted option and may default to same-division heats.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Advisory/conditional language: tracked as a compliance gap, NOT a mandatory hard blocker, and must not be enforced as one. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Conditional and permissive wording ('If ... allow', 'may'): not a hard blocker. Studio's planners do not co-mingle divisions in the same way and no equivalence is claimed.
decision_refs: OD-25 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now for Studio/Custom heat planning; Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
